sources.exact_use: Q1-Q28: canonical maximal reflection field and descent; bounded exact extraction; finite-preimage pole box; polynomial direction; uniform finite-fibre bound; no-direction critical-degree rigidity.

Extractor over QQ or a presented primitive number-field extension; exact marked factorization, bounded linear kernel, common-fibre gcd, normalized quotient and outer map. Seven bounded inputs and the displayed fibre controls; no generic complete fibre classifier is implemented.

FixedCoordinateFibreClassification parts1-2 and Sections2-3: all-order moment/reciprocity identity, exact finite pole allowances, full jet congruence and reconstruction. The new quotient removes its polynomial-generator hypothesis for the rational-unit parametrization.

Milne Fields and Galois Theory v5.10, Theorem9.19, Lemma9.24, Example9.25 and the proof printed pp117-120: arbitrary-field Luroth, rational-map field degree, fractional-linear generators, and generation by any nonconstant coefficient of the minimal polynomial. Actual retained statements and proof inspected by root and freshly reread by the separate Jacobian reviewer.

ElementaryRationalPointOrbit and ReciprocalExponentDecisionWithoutOrbitImport: full quotient-ring exponent decision. This is used only in SharperEffectiveFibreClassification after the quotient and pole box; not a premise of Q4, Q9, Q17, Q23 or Q25-Q28.

The uniform stable-height conclusion is identified with the concurrent sharp stabilization theorem. The no-direction bounds Q25-Q28 and all quotient/pole-box results are proved directly here and do not import that theorem.

primary_context.authors: Allem, Capaverde, van Hoeij and Szutkoski
primary_context.title: Functional Decomposition Using Principal Subfields
primary_context.inspection_scope: Root inspected actual Section2 and Theorem5.1 on PDFp7. Classical intermediate-field decomposition and minimal-polynomial coefficient extraction are comparison context. No complete subfield-lattice algorithm, complexity bound or uninspected theorem is imported.

dependency_separation.CanonicalReflectionQuotient: Luroth and rational-map field degree plus the written marked-place involution and Galois descent argument. No preexisting polynomial reciprocal generator is assumed.
dependency_separation.BoundedLinearReflectionExtraction: Written pole-divisor bound, marked anti-invariant kernel, common-fibre minimal polynomial and fractional-linear normalization; no full functional-decomposition oracle.
dependency_separation.UniversalReciprocalPoleBox: Canonical quotient and written anti-invariant divisor factorization, plus the retained exact local polynomiality interface; maximum ramification is over finite source preimages only.
dependency_separation.UniformFiniteFibreBound: Written product count and at-most-one survivor per nonperiodic forward orbit, not a finite enumeration theorem.
dependency_separation.NoPolynomialDirectionRigidity: Written ordinary-critical-divisor degree count, full jets and exact local pole orders; no inference that transient larger-cap examples exist.
dependency_separation.SharperEffectiveFibreClassification: Implemented quotient extraction, finite pole box and the separately proved elementary full-jet exponent procedure. The complete classifier remains an unimplemented proved procedure.

verification_scope.written_proof: Universal extraction, exhaustion, descent, finite-fibre bound and stable no-direction rigidity are written arguments, not inferred from finite controls.
verification_scope.checker: Seven exact quotient extractions over Q or Q(i); three finite-box candidates;12 polynomial pairs and36 raw even moments;8 thick-jet exponent cases;7 deliberately rejected shortcuts. Current hashes and outputs are in the receipt.
